name: Uwase
face: Young Rwandan girl about eight, with warm brown skin, a round face, large dark brown eyes, soft brows, and a bright open smile.
clothing: One-shoulder mushanana of purple, yellow, and white silk with a purple bow at the waist, and brown sandals. Gold hoop earrings and a gold bead necklace. No headwrap.
proportions: Natural proportions for a child of about eight: two arms, two legs, and five fingers on each hand.
distinctiveFeatures: Long dark wavy hair with a yellow flower and green leaves over one ear, gold hoop earrings, a gold bead necklace, and a purple bow at the waist. No headwrap.
